research_question: Is the Riemann hypothesis true, and how should a claimed recent breakthrough be assessed?
selected_direction: ProofBridge: An Auditable Li-Positivity and Tail-Exclusion Program
central_conclusion: The surveyed evidence supports rigorous finite verification, explicit zero-free regions, and exact equivalent criteria, but it does not support declaring the Riemann hypothesis proved. Recent repository declarations remain claims under audit until their full proof obligations are independently discharged.

evidence.survey_method: Dual-engine OpenAlex and AnySearch discovery, with cross-validated metadata retained in the survey manifest.

human_review_required: Verify bibliographic details against official DOI, publisher, and recognition records when browser access is available.
Obtain an analytic-number-theory review of any purported complete proof.
Review formalization imports and any future interval-certificate implementation independently.
